fusions.name: Couched Point
fusions.desc: Charges 7 tiles to the target with your weapon levelled, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampeding Thrusts
fusions.desc: Thrusts in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 6 damage to everything in it, each with a 20% chance to leave it [Enervated] for 5 seconds. Holds up to 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Spur On
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +5% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
